second_answer_attack.resolution: Calcium extrusion is important in cardiomyocytes, but JPH2 is a structural organizer of plasma/T-tubule-to-SR junctions. The experimental finding of disorganized junctional complexes directly targets dyad apposition, not NCX-mediated extrusion.

item.tested_construct: Desmoplakin is a desmosomal structural protein that anchors intermediate filaments to the desmosomal plaque, enabling mechanical coupling between cardiomyocytes. DSP variants can cause a left-dominant arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy with myocardial fibrosis, ventricular arrhythmias, and episodic myocardial injury.

blind_audit.rationale: Junctophilin-2 is a structural component of junctional complexes that bridge the plasma/T-tubule membrane and sarcoplasmic reticulum. These dyads position surface L-type calcium channels near intracellular ryanodine receptors, enabling efficient calcium-induced calcium release during cardiac excitation-contraction coupling. Strongest alternative resolved: Calcium extrusion is important in cardiomyocytes, but JPH2 is a structural organizer of plasma/T-tubule-to-SR junctions. The experimental finding of disorganized junctional complexes directly targets dyad apposition, not NCX-mediated extrusion.
